agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/sql.py Case.get_cases(): restored separate elif branches for skipping the CASE keyword vs. skipping whitespace (previously merged with 'or', causing non-matching tokens to fall through), and un-inverted the END keyword check (was 'not (token.match(...))', now correctly 'token.match(...)'). This bug caused mode to be reset to None for any token in a multi-token WHEN condition/value (e.g. BETWEEN ... AND ...) when skip_ws=False, truncating/corrupting the parsed case tuples used by the reindent and reindent_aligned formatters. Verified manually that sqlparse.format with reindent=True and reindent_aligned=True now produce correct, complete output for CASE statements combined with BETWEEN clauses.
